segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the final scope for the analytics workspace rollout and make sure the seat count and dates still line up on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that sounds good. We’re still looking at 42 standard seats and 6 admin seats for the first phase. Finance may add a few later, but not before go-live.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, 48 total for the initial order. The pricing sheet has that at $31,680 annually, billed upfront, with implementation at $4,500 one-time. Does that match what you had?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that’s what I have. We need the invoice dated after March 1, though, because it has to hit the new cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. If we get signature by February 23, we can set the contract start for March 1 and have billing generate the invoice that day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. On timing, our team wants the kickoff the week of March 11 and go-live by April 8. Is that still realistic?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. With your data file and user list by March 8, implementation can support an April 8 go-live. Training would be two 60-minute sessions the week before.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Please include the training sessions in the order form notes so I can point our operations lead to it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. The term is 12 months, auto-renewal with 60 days’ notice, and standard support included. Any redlines expected from legal?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, we already reviewed the template. Send the order form today, and I’ll route it for signature.
